description: We are joined by Abhishek Paudel, a PhD Student at George Mason University with a research focus on robotics, machine learning, and planning under uncertainty, using graph-based methods to enhance robot behavior. He explains how graph-based approaches can model environments, capture spatial relationships, and provide a framework for integrating multiple levels of planning and decision-making.
classificationReason: 直接讨论图方法、机器人行为、环境空间关系，以及多层规划与不确定性决策。
qualityReason: 为研究型访谈，嘉宾背景和技术主题明确，预计具有较强原创技术讨论价值。
